job.title: Sr. Data Scientist
job.pay_full: $173,500 – $213,100 a year base salary (New York City headquarters), plus annual equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan

details.about: Peloton provides expert instruction and world-class content for workouts at home, outdoors, traveling or at the gym, bringing together hardware, software and exclusive content for millions of Members. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City, it is looking for a Senior Data Scientist specialising in Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) to build and scale an in-house global marketing measurement capability: statistical models that measure the incremental impact of marketing across channels, funnel stages, products and markets, and turn the results into budget, scenario-planning and investment recommendations.
duties: Develop and enhance global Marketing Mix Models measuring incremental marketing impact across channels, products and markets
Work directly in the modeling code to diagnose, modify and extend it, and evaluate alternative specifications
Build adstock/carryover transformations and baseline and control variables (seasonality, promotions, pricing, macro factors)
Validate models with holdouts, out-of-sample tests and experiments, and diagnose issues like multicollinearity
Build response and saturation curves and measures such as incremental CAC, ROI and marginal effectiveness
Create budget optimisation and scenario-planning capabilities with real-world spend constraints
Turn findings into clear recommendations and executive presentations for Marketing, Media and Finance
Partner with Data Engineering and Analytics on pipelines, automation, QA and model governance
needs: 5–6+ years in Data Science, Marketing Science, Marketing Analytics, Econometrics or a related quantitative field
Hands-on experience developing and evolving Marketing Mix Models (direct MMM modeling experience is required)
Strong grasp of MMM methodology: adstock/carryover, response and saturation curves, diminishing returns, controls, specification and validation
Strong statistical programming in Python and/or R, with the ability to understand, debug, modify and extend modeling code
Experience across different MMM approaches and building response curves and budget optimisation or scenario-planning methods
Strong understanding of incrementality, CAC, ROI, marginal effectiveness, response rates, attribution and funnel dynamics
Ability to interpret how media strategy, buying, audience strategy and optimisation objectives affect performance
Ability to turn sophisticated analysis into clear business narratives and executive presentations, with strong communication and cross-functional skills
Experience building in-house MMM with custom and open-source frameworks
Experience measuring brand, search, site traffic or organic demand, and calibrating MMM with experiments, geo tests or holdouts
Data engineering and productionized modeling workflows; decision-support tools; Java, Tableau, or consumer/subscription/DTC experience
details.benefits: Base salary $173,500 – $213,100 a year for the New York City headquarters; the actual offer depends on experience, business objectives and location. Total rewards also include annual equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance; a generous paid time off policy; short- and long-term disability; access to mental health services; a 401(k), tuition reimbursement and student loan paydown plans; fertility and adoption support and up to 18 weeks of paid parental leave; child care and family care discounts; free access to the Peloton Digital App plus apparel and product discounts; commuter benefits and a Citi Bike discount; and pet insurance.
notes: Peloton never charges an application, processing or training fee; genuine recruiting emails come from an @onepeloton.com address
